title: Autosens feature not shown in settings
symptom: When using OpenAPS AMA mode, the function 'Use Autosens feature' is not shown in the AMA settings menu. It can only be found via the search function in settings.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but it is implied to be a bug in the settings menu display.
fix: A workaround is to activate SMB algorithm, go to its settings and disable dynamic sensitivity, then go back to AMA algorithm, and the option should appear. The bug is fixed in AAPS 4.0.0 via PR #5013.
evidence_quote: I reproduced the bug in dev environment. I will share a workaround. 1) activate SMB algorithm 2) go to its settings and disable dynamic sensitivity 3) go back to AMA algo again, you should see the option as expected.
